q: I don’t have a job and have cash assistance living with my parents however, living with my parents hasn’t been easy because they want me to use my cash assistance (it’s not enough to pay for gas, groceries, and any other necessities) if I pay for one thing I can’t pay for anything else.
cx: 29 weeks, craving foods she can't afford.

q: Nobody could’ve ever prepared me for the aversions and how genuinely frustrating it is.
cx: 29 weeks; post titled 'Nobody prepared me for this'.

q: I know everyone talks about how the first trimester can be rough but I wasn't actually prepared for how much it really, really *sucks.*
cx: First pregnancy, 5 to 6 weeks.

q: And while I know fitness watches aren't the most accurate in tracking sleep stages, my sleep scores haven't broken 45/100 in weeks.
cx: Waking at night since her positive test.

q: I've thanked him for his patience with me this last week as I haven't been getting to my portion of the household chores, and he just kisses my head and tells me that my body is doing really important work right now. But it doesn't feel earned.
cx: Her husband's response to her early-pregnancy slump.

q: Bump is forming, but I'm often bloated and it just looks like I've put on a bunch of fat around my midsection, it isn't round. That, plus none of my clothes fit, I got acne and I don't often have the will to make myself look nice especially when I don't have anything to wear.
cx: Formerly active; crossposted to r/pregnant.

q: I’m a mom to two kids, a 22 month old girl and a 6 week old boy. I’m on maternity leave till August, and my husband has been off but goes back in about a week. The toddler is in daycare.
cx: Six weeks after her second birth.

q: Husband and I are diving and conquering a lot now, which I get we have to do, but I feel isolated from whoever I’m not with, like there not enough of me to go around, and I feel guilty all the time.
cx: Splitting the toddler and the newborn between them.

q: With no relief, I finally just laid down flat in my bed with legs in a diamond shape and cried for an hour. It’s my dad’s birthday today and I have no clue how I’m going to manage going over to celebrate!
cx: First-time mother at 36+5 after trying stretches, ice and heat.

q: MIL comes over today and doesn’t ask anything about me, the baby, nothing but says “You sure you just have one baby in there?”
cx: 21 weeks with second child.

q: I was grocery shopping Thursday and an old lady asked if I was about to pop and if I was having twins.
cx: Comments from strangers at 21 weeks.

q: My pregnancy app says weight gain is going to slow way down after 34 weeks. I am wondering if this means that the bump won’t grow much after that.
cx: 33 weeks.

q: I kinda hope it is true that bump growth slows a lot now because all maternity clothes I got are getting to short in the front already. I can’t be bothered to buy new ones. 😅
cx: 33 weeks.

q: My husband is upset with me and told me that all I do is work, eat, and sleep. He told me that I am making our relationship all about the pregnancy symptoms I’m experiencing because I never want to go anywhere after work or do anything anymore.
cx: First pregnancy, 10 weeks, daycare worker on her feet all day.

q: He wouldn’t read it even if I did get it for him. I’ve offered and I’ve tried to explain stuff. I even asked my doctor questions in front of him and I feel like he still just doesn’t get it.
cx: Reply to a suggestion to give him a pregnancy book.

q: Trying to go for hypnobirthing/gas and air/ pool birth for pain relief and TENS machine but not opposed to pain relief , however I am really really hoping for that water birth
cx: First-time mum near the end of pregnancy.

q: I feel pretty ready, I had about 10 freakouts during 3rd trimester and when I think about it too much it still scares me ! It just feels so real now.
cx: Labour could start any time.

q: The following day we have our antenatal class and the midwife says that her husband made her lots of protein balls when she was pregnant and to keep as snacks while breastfeeding. This makes me really emotional and I leave the room for the loo.
cx: UK, 37 weeks, after arguing about who cooks.

q: At the end of the class I said something like “I was upset about the protein balls - that someone’s husband can do so much while mine is happy to feed me chicken nuggets and ketchup and not bat an eyelid”. And his response to this was “we can get some”.
cx: Her husband's answer.

q: Not bought for me but cooked for me. I work a very demanding job, am working till my due date, we have no family around us and I’m 37 weeks pregnant.
cx: What she has asked her husband for.

q: All I wanted was a hot girl summer. Instead I get another pregnancy summer? Dang it! We weren't even trying this time around! I even bought a cute bathing suit! I guess I am mourning the loss of my body autonomy again.
cx: Surprise third pregnancy; second child almost 2.

q: Birth was fine....it's the kids that are stressing me out! Lol
cx: Looking ahead to a third child.

q: With my first, everything happened so quickly that I didn’t even get a chance to look at water or any form of pain relief. I’ve been told second births can be quicker, so I’m trying to think ahead this time.
cx: UK, 27 weeks with second.

q: I’m currently 27 weeks and starting to think I should get a birth plan in place. I haven’t been stressing about it too much, but I feel like now is the time to start preparing.
cx: When she starts preparing the second time.

q: I have 10 more weeks left of work, along with an international work trip that I have to fly for (this involves a lot of walking around the city, our hotel is different from where all of the meetings are being held).
cx: UK, 28 weeks, home worker with coccyx and pelvic pain.

q: I’m so exhausted and fed up already, I cannot believe my third trimester has only just started and everyone says it gets so much worse.
cx: 28 weeks.

q: I have been referred to physio but the consultant but haven’t heard anything from them yet.
cx: Waiting on an NHS referral for pelvic pain.

q: I do think my part in the day could be done online so I am going to mention this at work, I’m just so nervous to say it!
cx: About the work trip.
